clips.title: The story
paras: In Shadowglen, young travelers carry harvested herbs south to Dolanaar. Porthannius entrusts them with the bundle for Innkeeper Keldamyr.

Fresh herbs from Aldrassil are bound for Dolanaar. Porthannius is occupied with matters among the druids of Shadowglen, so he entrusts the bundle to young travelers heading south along the road. They carry it to Innkeeper Keldamyr.
The parcel brings you to Dolanaar's inn, where Keldamyr receives it with gratitude. The inn offers weary travelers rest, peace of mind, and sanctuary before they venture deeper into Teldrassil.
